description.narrative:
The Wood Solution Thailand Programme also proposes an Engagement Phase, to be carried out from 1 March to 30 June 2026. This phase is designed as a standalone preparatory stage with clearly defined objectives and deliverables. The main purpose of the Engagement Phase is to mobilize partners, identify feasible pilot initiatives, and establish the institutional, technical, and financial conditions required to launch the full-scale programme.
The Engagement Phase project aims to achieve five main objectives:
Objective 1 Develop pilot initiatives: Create and support a portfolio of pilot projects across the entire value chain, from forest to construction. This includes helping pioneer teams in Thailand and Laos further develop their concepts, build partnerships with Swedish actors, and prepare for feasibility testing.
Objective 2 Initiate a Thai programme organization: Begin establishing the institutional structure in Thailand that will eventually lead and manage the Wood Solution Thailand Programme. This includes identifying key actors and designing a governance and management model.
Objective 3 Build the Wood Solution Support Platform: Establish the first version of an international expert and innovation platform, anchored in Sweden, which will provide technical support, research collaboration, and matchmaking with Swedish companies.
Objective 4 Develop financing partnerships: Engage potential bilateral, multilateral, philanthropic, and private financiers to design a coordinated financing strategy and prepare proposals for the next programme phase.
Objective 5 Strengthen ThaiSwedish forest sector cooperation: Promote structured partnerships between Thai and Swedish companies, academia, government agencies, and civil society in line with the Thai-Swedish strategic partnership, with a focus on joint efforts to advance a sustainable timber construction sector.
